'''Rina Hafden''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] and for a while a loyalist [[Sitter]] of the [[Green Ajah]].

== Appearance and Personality ==
She is described as being elegant despite being stocky. 
She has a square face and an upturned nose. She is a fierce, tenacious and determined woman, not easily daunted.

==Strength and Abilities==
Rina has a strength in the [[One Power]] of {{opsl|28}}, [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|average]] for an Aes Sedai. She would not be strong enough to [[Traveling|Travel]] unless she has an above average skill in the Talent.

==History==
Rina is 77 years old. She was born in the year {{ne|923}} and went to the [[White Tower]] in {{ne|938}}. After spending nine years as novice and eight as Accepted she was raised to the [[shawl]] in the year [[955 NE]].

At the time of the [[Aiel War]] Rina had two [[Warder]]s, [[Waylin]] and [[Elyas Machera]] {{Ref/book|0|7}}, later she masked the [[Bond]] between herself and Elyas after he ran away when he discovered he was a [[Wolfbrother]].

Rina gave up hunting for him actively. She let him go in large part because she knew the [[Red Ajah|Red]] sisters who had accused him of being a [[Darkfriend]] might well kill him no matter what she tried to do. None of which meant she did not want him back; he was hers by Aes Sedai rights, and they were probably married.

==Activities==
After the schism in the White Tower, when [[Joline Maza]] was unchaired by [[Elaida a'Roihan]] and sent to [[Ebou Dar]], [[Adelorna Bastine]], the head of the Green Ajah, picks Rina as new the Sitter for the Green Ajah, although she was young for the position.

Rina is present when Elaida grants the Sitters requests to begin negotiations with the [[Rebel Aes Sedai]].

Rina did not remain a Sitter after the [[White Tower Schism]] was over.{{Ref/book|13|27}}
